verdict: Verified root cause identified for finance SSO failure: SAML signing certificate dropped during identity-service 3.4 migration, which also explains the failed Sep 26 fix.

sentences.text: Finance users could not sign in via SSO after the identity migration because the identity-service 3.4 migration dropped the SAML signing certificate from the tenant config.
The same dropped SAML signing certificate explains why the Sep 26 SSO fix still fails.
The SSO root cause has been established: the SAML signing certificate was dropped from the tenant config during the identity-service 3.4 migration.
